# Browser

Browser opens web pages as a computer's browser does: it runs their JavaScript, so it shows the
sites [Web Lite](../apps/web-lite.md) cannot, such as maps and web apps. It is slower to start
than Web Lite and uses more memory. The phone needs internet (Wi-Fi or mobile data).

Browser is not part of the firmware: it is [installed separately](index.md#installing-an-app)
with its web engine, about 165 MB, and then shows up in the menu under **Internet & media**.

## Opening a page

Browser opens on its start page, **Start**, with links to a few sites (Wikipedia, Hacker News,
OpenStreetMap, GitHub, DuckDuckGo, and Speedometer to measure how fast it is). Under them,
**JavaScript works:** says that scripts run.

To go somewhere else:

1. Tap the **Address or search** field at the bottom. The keyboard opens.
2. Type an address, such as `en.wikipedia.org`, or words to search for.
3. Press Enter.

An address without `https://` gets it added. Words, or anything that is not an address, are
searched for on DuckDuckGo. To leave the field without going anywhere, hide the keyboard with
its :fontawesome-solid-keyboard: key: the field shows the page's address again.

While a page loads, the title says **Loading...** and the :fontawesome-solid-xmark: button at the
right of the field stops it. Once loaded, the title is the page's, and the
:fontawesome-solid-arrows-rotate: button loads it again.

## Reading and moving around

Scroll with your finger, and tap links to follow them. Pages get their mobile version, as on a
phone's browser. A link that would open a new tab or window opens in the same view.

To go back to the previous page, tap the :fontawesome-solid-chevron-left: back button at the
left of the field. On the first page, it closes Browser, as the
:fontawesome-solid-chevron-left: back arrow at the top does.

Browser keeps cookies and what sites store (their settings, a consent you gave), also after you
close it.

When a page cannot load (no internet, a wrong address), the web engine shows why in the page.

## Limitations

- Text fields of a page (logins, a site's own search box, forms) cannot be typed in yet: search
  with the address field instead.
- No videos or sound.
- No zooming with two fingers, no tabs, bookmarks, history list or downloads.
- When a page uses too much memory, it loads again from the start without a word.
